data.one_liner: Detects URLs and emails in text and opens them in the browser when tapped.
data.what_it_does: LinkWell is a text widget that automatically detects URLs and emails within a string. When tapped, it opens the corresponding link or email in the user's browser. It also allows styling links and non-links separately, and providing custom names for links.
use_when: You need to display text containing URLs and emails that users can tap to open.
You need to customize the appearance of links versus regular text.
You need to rename specific URLs in a text string.
avoid_when: You require complex rich text formatting beyond basic text styles and simple link/email detection.
You need non-browser custom interception for link clicks.
strengths: Detects both URLs and email addresses out of the box.
Supports custom styling for links and non-links separately.
Allows renaming specific URLs using a map of names.
weaknesses: Limited to opening URLs and emails in the user's browser.
